note: Round 11 remaster, west + map shots. Camera in round-4 blockout metres (x east, z south, y up; layout.js). Eye 1.7 m, horseback 2.6 m. Grey frames are 2:3 portrait (402 x 603 CSS px on the iPhone 16 Pro profile).

shots.title: The town gate plaza
shots.caption: Just inside the East Gate: the quest board and its three tier givers, the 22 m obelisk, Main Street beyond.
shots.screen: SCREEN: the town's gate plaza at eye height, just inside the East Gate. The tall orange spire on the left is THE OBELISK. The orange panel ahead is the quest board: give it a "QUESTS" stencil header and pinned paper notices. The three grey capsules in front of it become three town NPC dev-bots (the quest givers): over the right-hand one (the Yard Boss) a big glowing yellow "!", over the other two (the Surveyor, the Shift Boss) the same "!" in flat grey. Small name tags over them, left to right: "SHIFT BOSS", "SURVEYOR", "YARD BOSS". The grey box with dark posts at the far left and the box under the cyan awning at the right are market stalls: add crates and goods on them. The houses keep their shapes. HUD values: Scrip "0", objective "◆ TALK TO THE YARD BOSS", "LV 1" with the XP bar nearly empty; SWAP shows a sword.

shots.title: The kill-contract board
shots.caption: CONTRACTS in the gate plaza: kill contracts for Scrip, a trophy and a joke title the first time; grey rows wait for your level.
shots.screen:
SCREEN: close up on the kill-contract board in the gate plaza. The big dark-orange panel is the CONTRACTS board: an orange dev-block frame with a stencil header "CONTRACTS" and pinned wanted-style notices with robot silhouettes. Over the lower-middle of the screen (above the XP bar) a HUD panel titled "KILL CONTRACTS" with six rows (name, level, a gold coin icon and Scrip, a button):
"10 CRATE MITES" "LV 1–3" "20" "CLAIM"
"10 PALLET JACKS" "LV 4–6" "40" "ACCEPT"
"BIG PALLET · ELITE" "LV 6" "120" "ACCEPT"
"10 PLUMB DRONES" "LV 7–9" "70" with a lock icon
"VAULT WARDEN · ELITE" "LV 12" "300" with a lock icon
"THE CRATE TITAN" "LV 20" "1000" with a lock icon
The locked rows are dimmed grey. Under the rows a small line "FIRST CLEAR: SCRIP + TROPHY + TITLE". HUD values: Scrip "120", objective "◆ PICK A CONTRACT", "LV 5"; SWAP shows a sword.

shots.title: A quest you are too low for
shots.caption: The Surveyor (L7-12) wears a grey ! at LV 4: the accept button says REQUIRES LV 7.
shots.screen: SCREEN: a quest giver you are too low for. The grey capsule in the centre becomes the Surveyor, a town NPC dev-bot holding a rolled survey map, facing the camera; the "!" over its head is flat GREY (not yellow), because the player is too low. The orange panel behind it is the quest board ("QUESTS" stencil, pinned notices). In the lower part of the screen (above the XP bar) a HUD dialogue panel: name line "SURVEYOR · LV 7–12", quest title "DRONE SEASON", the line "Plumb Drones are thick over band 3. Come back when you can hold your own.", and two buttons: a dimmed one with a lock icon "REQUIRES LV 7" and a cyan-outlined "LATER". HUD values: Scrip "60", objective "◆ TALK TO THE SURVEYOR", "LV 4"; SWAP shows a sword.

shots.title: Tinker Rook's UPGRADES
shots.caption: Main Street: one-off upgrades for Scrip and parts, locked by level; BENCH makes ammo. No potions, no heals.
shots.screen:
SCREEN: Tinker Rook's shop on Main Street. The orange building is his shop: a black stencil "TINKER ROOK" on its front above the cyan awning. The cyan capsule under the awning becomes Tinker Rook, a town NPC dev-bot in a leather apron with a wrench. Over the middle of the screen a HUD shop panel: header "TINKER ROOK" with the Scrip count "260"; two tabs "UPGRADES" (active) and "BENCH"; five rows (name, one-line effect, level, a gold coin icon and Scrip price, parts, a button):
"FORGE I · IRON" "weapon base 17" "LV 5" "80" "6 TINE" "BUY"
"STURDY HEART I" "+10 % max HP" "LV 3" "60" "5 SERVO" "OWNED"
"QUIVER STRAP" "+6 arrows and bolts" "LV 4" "60" "4 TINE" "BUY"
"HOVER GRIP" "tighter board turns" "LV 2" "100" "3 SERVO" "BUY"
"FORGE II · STEEL" "weapon base 22" "LV 9" "300" "8 ROTOR" with a lock icon "REQUIRES LV 9" (dimmed)
No potions or healing items anywhere. HUD values: Scrip "260", objective "◆ BUY AN UPGRADE", "LV 6"; SWAP shows a sword.

shots.title: Weapon range, lever rifle
shots.caption: The rifle lane: targets at 25, 50 and 75 m into the berm; hit numbers, no enemies, pays nothing.
shots.screen: SCREEN: first person on the weapon range's lever-rifle lane. The player holds a lever-action rifle (wood stock, dark steel) in the lower right, aimed down the lane. The dark-grey long block on the left is the lane wall: stencil "LEVER RIFLE" on it. The target boards down the lane become round red-and-white bullseye targets on stands, with small distance plates "25", "50", "75" over them; a floating hit number "38" with a small tag "BULLSEYE" over the 75 m target. The long dark-grey block at the far end is the earth berm faced with dev-blocks. A small ammo chip "6 / 6" above the ATTACK button. HUD values: Scrip "45", objective "◆ HIT ALL THREE TARGETS", "LV 3"; SWAP and ATTACK show a rifle.

shots.title: Crossbow ammo practice
shots.caption: The crossbow ammo lane: plank (iron), straw bale (pitch sets it alight), soft dummy (broadhead) at 20 m.
shots.screen: SCREEN: first person in the crossbow ammo lane. The player holds a loaded crossbow (dark steel and wood) in the lower right. The targets at 20 m keep their shapes: the tall board becomes a thick wooden plank target with a red bullseye (iron bolts), the grey box becomes a straw bale burning with small pitch flames, the orange capsule becomes a soft padded training dummy. Next to the ATTACK button, an ammo picker of three small round buttons stacked upward: "IRON", "PITCH" (selected, glowing orange) and "BROADHEAD", with a tag "PITCH · SETS TARGETS ALIGHT". HUD values: Scrip "45", objective "◆ TRY ALL THREE BOLTS", "LV 3"; SWAP and ATTACK show a crossbow.

shots.title: Hover park, kicker run-up
shots.caption: On the board in the middle run-up lane: three kickers (1.6, 2.4, 3.2 m), the 45 m halfpipe beyond, a running trick score.
shots.screen: SCREEN: riding a hoverboard down the middle cyan run-up lane of the hover park. Keep the cyan lanes and the three orange kicker ramps exactly. At the bottom centre, just above the XP bar, the glowing cyan nose of the player's hoverboard. Top centre of the screen a trick score readout: big "1,250", under it "KICKFLIP +250" and "COMBO ×3". The "HOVER" button on the left edge is lit cyan (active). HUD values: Scrip "45", objective "◆ SCORE 2,000 IN ONE RUN", "LV 3"; SWAP shows a sword.

shots.title: Grapple tower top, the zip
shots.caption: Hook 5, top of the 45 m tower: the 99 m zipline runs back over the town wall to the finish on the zip-house roof.
shots.screen: SCREEN: standing on top of THE GRAPPLE TOWER (hook 5), 45 m up, looking back east over the course to the town. The thin dark line rising from the bottom centre to the cyan roof in the town is THE ZIPLINE (one steel cable). The cyan disc with the small board on the ground below is the grapple start pad and its PERSONAL-BEST board; the dark pole with the cyan ball on the left is a hook pole. The town beyond keeps every house; its cyan-topped building is the zip house, the finish. Top centre a course timer chip "GRAPPLE 0:41.2" with "PB 0:38.9" under it. HUD values: Scrip "45", objective "◆ ZIP TO THE FINISH", "LV 3"; SWAP shows a sword.

shots.title: The movers sequence
shots.caption: Six numbered stations rising east to west: conveyors, jump pads, sliders over the pit, the spinner, the lift, the top deck.
shots.screen: SCREEN: at the start of the movers sequence, looking along the run. Keep every block: the dark conveyor belts with cyan chevrons in the right foreground, the cyan jump-pad discs, the orange ledge on dark legs, the dark lift shaft, the top deck, and the off-white water tank behind (THE WATER TANK). Add large black stencil station numbers on the stations: "1" on the conveyors, "2" by the jump pads, "3" on the sliding platforms, "4" on the spinner, "5" on the lift, "6" on the top deck. The two dark poles with cyan balls on the left are hook poles. Top centre a course timer chip "MOVERS 0:12.4" with "PB 1:05.0" under it. HUD values: Scrip "45", objective "◆ REACH THE TOP DECK", "LV 3"; SWAP shows a sword.

shots.title: Riding course, the start
shots.caption: On the loaner horse from the stable hand: the start/finish gantry with the lap timer, rings down the straight. Course only.
shots.screen: SCREEN: on horseback (eye 2.6 m) at the start of the riding course. Keep the track, the white rails and the cyan rings. The dark-orange frame across the track is the start/finish gantry: stencil "START · FINISH" on its beam and a glowing lap-timer display. Riders see the loaner horse's blocky dev-bot head and ears (orange and grey chamfered blocks) at the bottom centre, just above the XP bar. Top centre a lap chip "LAP 1 / 3" with "0:04.6" and "RINGS 0 / 8". The "HORSE" button on the left edge is lit cyan (riding). HUD values: Scrip "45", objective "◆ RIDE THE COURSE", "LV 3"; SWAP shows a sword.

shots.title: The Rock lookout, vista 1
shots.caption: The bench on top of the Rock: the climb yard, the town and its obelisk in one frame; a FINDS toast.
shots.screen: SCREEN: on top of THE ROCK at the lookout, 16 m up, looking north-east over the town. The two white blocks in the foreground are the lookout bench and its footrest: make them a simple wood-and-steel bench. Beyond: the climb yard's rope bridges and decks, THE ZIPLINE, the town with its houses. On the right, under the minimap, a FINDS toast "★ FOUND · ROCK LOOKOUT" with "VISTAS 1 / 8". HUD values: Scrip "45", objective "◆ SIT ON THE BENCH", "LV 3"; SWAP shows a sword.

shots.title: Squeeze cave and cache 2
shots.caption: Behind the Rock: hidden cache 2 at its foot, the squeeze cave's south mouth (60 m through) in the rock face.
shots.screen: SCREEN: behind THE ROCK at its foot. The grey crag ahead is THE ROCK; the dark block at its base on the right is the squeeze cave's south mouth: make it a low dark cave opening with a little lamp light inside. The grey steps up its left face are the scramble route. The small cyan cube on the left is hidden cache 2: a small glowing cyan dev-crate with a latch. The rope bridges on the far right come from the climb yard. A small prompt "OPEN CACHE" by the cyan cube. On the right, under the minimap, a FINDS toast "◆ FOUND · CACHE 2" with "CACHES 1 / 4". HUD values: Scrip "45", objective "◆ FIND THE HIDDEN CACHES", "LV 3"; SWAP shows a sword.

shots.title: The trophy wall
shots.caption: Twelve frames in the gate plaza: elite and boss trophies, each with an always-on perk.
shots.screen: SCREEN: the trophy wall in the gate plaza. The orange wall with twelve square frames is the trophy wall: a stencil header "TROPHIES" above it. The first three frames hold trophies (a pair of forklift tines, a riveted steel plate, a hard hat); every other frame is empty with a small "?". Over the lower-middle of the screen a HUD card: "BIG PALLET'S TINES", "+5 % damage to crate robots", and a cyan pill "PERK ON". HUD values: Scrip "310", objective "◆ HANG YOUR NEXT TROPHY", "LV 13"; SWAP shows a sword.

shots.title: Top-down, west vs east

shots.screen: SCREEN: a straight-down developer camera over the whole 500 m cell, north up. Keep every shape of the map exactly: the walled town left of centre, the riding oval top-left, the toys round the town, the seam wall down the middle, the coloured level bands on the right, the round gauntlet and the round Titan amphitheatre bottom-right. Turn the plain colours into dev-textures and tiny real props; the band floors keep their colours. Small map labels with dark backing, placed on their areas: "WEST · NO ENEMIES" over the left half, "EAST · COMBAT" over the right half, "TOWN", "RIDING COURSE", "HOVER PARK", "WEAPON RANGE", and on the bands "LV 1–3", "LV 4–6", "LV 7–9", "LV 10–12", "LV 13–15", "LV 16–18", and "CRATE TITAN · LV 20" on the bottom-right amphitheatre. The grey ground outside the cell stays plain. HUD values: Scrip "0", objective "◆ OPEN THE EAST GATE", "LV 1"; SWAP shows a sword.

shots.title: BAG > MAP
shots.caption: The pause map: every zone named, each band with its level range, you at the quest board.
shots.screen: SCREEN: NOT the in-world HUD. The pause BAG screen with the MAP tab open, full screen. Top: a dark navy header with a "CLOSE" button at the left and the title "BAG" with "SHOWCASE TEMPLATE" under it; under the header a row of five icon tabs "MAP" (active, cyan underline), "GEAR", "FINDS", "PACK", "FEATS". The middle is the map: the attached top-down cell, kept exactly (every zone, the town, the oval, the bands, the arenas), rendered as a clean painted top-down game map inside a cyan hairline frame. Map labels with dark backing on their areas: "TOWN", "RIDING COURSE", "MOVERS", "GRAPPLE", "THE ROCK", "HOVER PARK", "WEAPON RANGE", "PHYSICS YARD", "LV 1–3", "LV 4–6", "LV 7–9", "LV 10–12", "STEALTH YARD · LV 13–15", "LV 16–18", "GAUNTLET", "CRATE TITAN · LV 20". A cyan player arrow in the town's plaza. The plain grey above and below the cell is covered by the UI. Bottom: zoom chips "1×" (active) "2×" "4×", a legend "◆ QUEST" "▲ YOU", and a hint line "DRAG TO PAN · PINCH TO ZOOM".

shots.title: Minimap at the East Gate
shots.caption: At the town's East Gate: calm grey west on the minimap, the band 1 enemy dots across the seam.
shots.screen: SCREEN: standing in the town's East Gate, looking east: the seam avenue, the seam gate's two dark-orange posts and the walled combat road beyond (THE SEAM WALL style). No enemies in view. The minimap is the subject: draw it a little larger than usual, split down its middle: the left (west) half calm flat grey, the right (east) half tinted green for band 1 with four small red enemy dots; the player arrow on the split line. Under the minimap a chip "ENTERING · LV 1–3" and under that the objective chip "◆ CLEAR 10 CRATE MITES". HUD values: Scrip "0", "LV 1"; SWAP shows a sword.

shots.title: MAP, level heat map on
shots.caption: The map with the heat map on: danger by level band, elite and Titan skulls.
shots.screen: SCREEN: NOT the in-world HUD. The pause BAG screen, MAP tab, with the level heat map on, full screen. Top: header with "CLOSE" and "BAG" / "SHOWCASE TEMPLATE", tabs "MAP" (active), "GEAR", "FINDS", "PACK", "FEATS"; under them a strip "DANGER BY LEVEL" with six colour keys "1–3" (green) "4–6" (yellow) "7–9" (orange) "10–12" (red) "13–15" (crimson) "16–18" (purple) and a toggle "HEAT MAP · ON". The middle is the attached top-down cell kept exactly, as a painted map, with a translucent heat tint over each combat band in its key colour (the bands are where the screenshot's coloured floors are); the whole west half stays calm grey with the label "NO ENEMIES". Skull markers with level numbers: "6" at Big Pallet's pit (top band area), "12" at the Training Vault (right edge), "18" on the round gauntlet (bottom middle-right), and a crowned skull "20" on the Titan's round amphitheatre (bottom right). A cyan player arrow in the town plaza. Bottom: zoom chips "1×" "2×" "4×" and "DRAG TO PAN · PINCH TO ZOOM".

shots.title: The East Gate from the plaza
shots.caption: The only way into combat: the town's East Gate, and the seam gate across the avenue beyond it.
shots.screen: SCREEN: in the gate plaza looking east at the town's East Gate. The two tall blocks are the East Gate's gatehouse towers and the dark-orange frame between them is the gate (THE TOWN WALL style): a stencil "EAST GATE" on its lintel. Small stencilled signs on the gatehouses: left "TOWN · NO ENEMIES", right "COMBAT · LV 1–20 →". The box under the small roof on the right is a market stall. Far through the gate, the seam gate posts. HUD values: Scrip "0", objective "◆ LEAVE BY THE EAST GATE", "LV 1"; SWAP shows a sword.
